summary_en: YRGLM Inc. will acquire 100 shares of EC-CUBE Inc. held by Orient Corporation for 155 million yen, raising its ownership from 90.0% to 100%. The acquisition terminates the capital partnership established in December 2020 as the initial collaboration objectives have been fulfilled, while operational partnerships remain unchanged.
title_en: Notice on Complete Acquisition of Subsidiary Shares (Termination of Capital Partnership with Orient Corporation)
translation_en_brief:
YRGLM Inc. announced on November 17, 2026, that its board of directors approved the acquisition of 100 shares of EC-CUBE Inc. from Orient Corporation, raising YRGLM's ownership stake from 90.0% to 100% and making EC-CUBE a wholly owned subsidiary. The acquisition price is 155 million yen, calculated at 1.55 million yen per share using a simplified DCF method based on recent operational performance, consistent with the price YRGLM had paid when transferring these shares to Orient Corporation in December 2020.

The transaction terminates the capital partnership between the two companies established in December 2020, when YRGLM and Orient Corporation collaborated to promote an EC platform service ("ec-cube.co") to Orient Corporation's affiliated merchants. The parties determined that this initial partnership objective had run its course as EC-CUBE's business focus expanded to encompassing EC-CUBE Enterprise package development and broader EC construction support services. The acquisition aims to accelerate value creation for the entire YRGLM group by expediting decision-making and optimizing resource allocation through complete managerial control.

The transaction is a capital structure adjustment only. EC-CUBE and Orient Corporation will maintain their operational partnership, service contracts, and other business relationships without interruption, with both companies continuing to cooperate by leveraging their respective strengths. The shareholder agreement signed in December 2020 will terminate upon execution of the share transfer.
